sommelier.name: Amara
sommelier.title: AI Chocolate Sommelier
sommelier.intro: Tell me what you crave — fruit, roast, crunch, or silk — and I’ll map a tasting path through the catalogue.
starterPrompts: I want something nutty with caramel.
Surprise me with a dark bar under $3.
What should I try from South Africa?

chatPreview.user: Something nutty with a soft caramel finish?
chatPreview.ai: Start with Lunch Bar — peanuts, caramel, and wafer in a nostalgic bite. Then try Mars if you want more nougat softness.

cannedReplies.reply: Lean into Lunch Bar for peanut-caramel crunch, then Mars for a softer nougat finish. Both sit well as everyday tasting anchors.
Reach for Tokara Dark — cocoa-forward with a clean finish. If you want something more approachable, Dairy Milk eases you back toward cream.
KitKat is the classic crispy wafer path. Pair it with Lunch Bar if you want nuts and caramel in the same session.
Dairy Milk keeps things smooth and milky. For contrast later, note how fruit-leaning dark bars brighten against that creaminess.
Share a flavor direction — Fruity, Dark, Nutty, Caramel, Crispy, or Smooth — and I’ll pick a short tasting flight from the catalogue.
